description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Collection' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Collection / album / codex definitions — sets of items, cards, characters or achievements players collect. Defines what counts as the collection, completion rewards, and tier/rarity grouping. Use for compendium-style meta content.

x-enum-descriptions: Platform was not reported, or the reported one contradicts the request fingerprint.
Browser: web build, WebGL, or a messenger mini-app.

CollectibleDefinition.description: A single Collectible (analogous to a sticker in an album). The base unit of a collection. May have a Special version.

AssetPaths.description: Paths to Collectible assets (regular and Special version images). The client decides which asset belongs to which version.

CollectibleID.description: Unique ID of the Collectible within the collection. Used as the key in player state dictionaries.

HasSpecialVersion.description: Whether a Special version of this Collectible exists. Special versions trade only during SpecialTradeEventDefinition windows. CollectibleJoker cannot be used to obtain a Special version.

Rarity.description: Rarity of the Collectible: 1 (common) to 5 (legendary). Affects drop frequency, CollectionCurrency yield on duplicate conversion, and CollectionChest availability.

SortOrder.description: Display order of the Collectible within the Set (lower = earlier).

CollectionChestDefinition.description: CollectionChest — Pity System mechanic. Player spends CollectionCurrency (accrued from duplicates) and receives guaranteed Collectibles with a minimum rarity. Three standard tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold.

AssetPaths.description: Paths to CollectionChest assets (image, opening animation).

BonusRewardSlots.description: Weighted pools of bonus rewards granted alongside Collectibles. Same mechanism as LootboxV2: each slot independently performs [MinRolls, MaxRolls] rolls over its Pool with AmountRange and weights support. When Presets.BonusRewardSlots is set, merged with the preset by SlotID key (preset base + inline override/add).

CollectionChestID.description: Unique ID of the CollectionChest within the title. Example: "CollectionChest_bronze", "CollectionChest_silver", "CollectionChest_gold".

CollectionCurrencyCost.description: Cost of opening the CollectionChest in CollectionCurrency.

GuaranteedMinRarity.description: Minimum guaranteed rarity of Collectibles from the CollectionChest. All dropped Collectibles will have rarity at least this value.

MaxCollectibleCount.description: Maximum number of Collectibles granted from the CollectionChest. Actual count is chosen randomly in [MinCollectibleCount; MaxCollectibleCount].

MaxOpenCount.description: Max chests of THIS type per single OpenCollectionChest call. Overrides CollectionGlobalSettings.MaxChestOpenCount. null = fall back to the module setting, then to the platform default. <= 0 = this chest cannot be opened. Read only via CollectionDefinitionDefaults.EffectiveMaxChestOpenCount.

MinCollectibleCount.description: Minimum number of Collectibles granted from the CollectionChest.

PityRules.description: Pity rules. Behaves identically to LootboxV2: every Threshold openings guarantees one roll from the rule's Pool. Counters live in UserCollectionState.PityCounters. When Presets.PityRules is set, merged with the preset by RuleID key (preset base + inline override/add).

Presets.description: Container of chest preset wiring (bonus slots / pity rules). Registry is this module's CollectionDefinitions.RewardPools. null = presets unused.

Tier.description: Visual CollectionChest tier for sorting and UI display. 1 = Bronze, 2 = Silver, 3 = Gold.

CollectionDefinition.description: A single collection — top level of the hierarchy. Groups all Sets of one thematic (season) bundle. Completing it (all Collectibles + all Gold) grants the Grand Prize.

AssetPaths.description: Paths to collection assets (album cover, background art). Order and purpose are determined by the client.

CollectionID.description: Unique ID of the collection within the title. Used as the key in CollectionDefinitions.Collections.

Description.description: Description of the collection for UI.

GrandPrize.description: Grand Prize for full collection completion (grant only).

SeasonChainID.description: Optional binding to a season chain. null — the collection operates independently of the season system. If set — collection wipe is synced with season change.

Sets.description: All Sets in the collection (analogous to album pages). Display order is determined by CollectionSetDefinition.SortOrder.

CollectionGlobalSettings.description: Module-wide Collection settings. Each value applies to every collection and pack type of the title unless the entity overrides it.

MaxChestOpenCount.description: Same for collection chests (OpenCollectionChest). A separate setting rather than shared with packs: chests are bought with duplicate currency and may warrant a different cap. Overridden per chest via CollectionChestDefinition.MaxOpenCount.

MaxPackOpenCount.description: Max packs per single OpenPack call for every pack type of the title. Overridden per pack type via CollectionPackTypeDefinition.MaxOpenCount. null = platform default (CollectionDefinitionDefaults.DefaultMaxPackOpenCount). <= 0 = opening disabled. A client-requested count is CLAMPED to this ceiling, not rejected.

CollectionPackTypeDefinition.description: Pack type for the collection (lootbox). Defines Collectible count, rarity guarantees and drop weights. Example tiers by color: Green -> Blue -> Orange -> Purple.

AssetPaths.description: Paths to pack assets (image, opening animation).

BonusRewardSlots.description: Weighted pools of bonus rewards granted alongside Collectibles. Each slot independently performs [MinRolls, MaxRolls] rolls over its Pool. Uses the same mechanism as LootboxV2. When Presets.BonusRewardSlots is set, merged with the preset by SlotID key (preset base + inline override/add).

CollectibleCount.description: Total Collectible count in the pack. Typical values: 3 (Green), 4 (Blue/Orange), 5 (Purple).

ColorTier.description: Visual tier of the pack for sorting and UI. 1 = Green, 2 = Blue, 3 = Orange, 4 = Purple.

GuaranteeMaxRarity.description: If true, the pack guarantees at least one Collectible of maximum rarity (5 stars). Used for Purple packs.

GuaranteedMinRarity.description: Guaranteed minimum rarity for at least one Collectible in the pack. Remaining slots are filled according to RarityWeights.

MaxOpenCount.description: Max packs of THIS type per single OpenPack call. Overrides CollectionGlobalSettings.MaxPackOpenCount. null = fall back to the module setting, then to CollectionDefinitionDefaults.DefaultMaxPackOpenCount. <= 0 = this pack type cannot be opened. Read only via CollectionDefinitionDefaults.EffectiveMaxPackOpenCount.

PackTypeID.description: Unique pack type ID. Recommended values: "green", "blue", "orange", "purple".

PityRules.description: Pack pity rules. Behaves identically to LootboxV2: every Threshold openings of this pack guarantees one roll from the rule's Pool. Counters live in UserCollectionState.PityCounters. When Presets.PityRules is set, merged with the preset by RuleID key (preset base + inline override/add).

Presets.description: Container of pack preset wiring (bonus slots / pity rules). Registry is this module's CollectionDefinitions.RewardPools. null = presets unused.

PriceOptions.description: Ways to pay. Dictionary key = PriceOption.OptionID; the player picks one. Empty/null = free.

RarityWeights.description: Collectible drop weights by rarity for non-guaranteed slots. Key is rarity as string ("1".."5"), value is an arbitrary weight. Server normalizes: P(rarity) = weight / sum(all weights).

CollectionRewardPresetBindings.description: Container of reward preset wiring for PackType/Chest — one PresetBinding per block. Inline data (BonusRewardSlots/PityRules) lives on the entity. Resolved via RewardSlotHelpers over PresetResolver. null = presets unused.

BonusRewardSlots.description: Bonus reward-slot preset binding (merge by SlotID).

CollectionSetDefinition.description: Set — a thematic group of Collectibles inside a collection (analogous to an album page). Completing the Set (all Collectibles collected) grants SetCompletionReward.

AssetPaths.description: Paths to Set assets (page cover, thematic illustration).

Collectibles.description: Collectibles that belong to the Set. Typically 9, but the count is configurable.

SetCompletionReward.description: One-time reward for completing the Set (grant only).

SetID.description: Unique ID of the Set within the collection.

SortOrder.description: Display order of the Set within the collection (lower = earlier).

DuplicateCollectionCurrencyConversion.description: Rule for automatically converting a duplicate Collectible into CollectionCurrency. Conversion happens instantly upon receiving a duplicate; the duplicate does not enter inventory. CollectionCurrency accrues in UserCollectionState.CollectionCurrencyBalance.

CollectionCurrencyGranted.description: Amount of CollectionCurrency credited to the balance per converted duplicate.

Rarity.description: Rarity of the duplicate Collectible (1-5). Must match CollectibleDefinition.Rarity.

EventTokenAddress.description: Universal event-token address. Uniquely identifies the system and event the tokens belong to.

EntityID.description: Event identifier within the system. In TITLE CONFIG (rewards written by a designer or an AI agent) scheduled systems use the SHORT form — the cycle number is unknowable at config time: "{TimedEventID}" / "{LeaderboardID}" = whichever instance is active at grant time, or "{ID}:{ChainedEventID}" = that chain phase in the current cycle. The engine (EventTokenAddressResolver in ResourceService) expands it before granting; a grant with no active instance is dropped. At RUNTIME the bucket address is always the full form "{EntityID}:{InstanceKey}": TimedEvent Scheduled → "{TimedEventID}:s{yyyyMMddHHmm}"; TimedEvent Chain → "{chainID}:{cycleIndex}:{chainedEventID}"; Leaderboard → "{leaderboardID}:{instanceKey}"; CoopEvent → CoopChainID; Season → SeasonChainID.

EventTokenOperation.description: Information about granted event tokens. Returned in Board_Roll, QuestComplete and other responses. All multipliers (Roll/Premium/BonusWindow/ProgressiveTier/SeasonBuffs) are applied via ModifierService before ResourceService; this carries the final amount. Use ModifierApplyResult alongside ResourceOperation if UI needs multiplier breakdown.

Address.description: Event token address — where to grant or consume.

Amount.description: Token amount — how many to grant or consume.

Source.description: Operation source (sourceKey used for analytics and limits).

Max.description: Maximum Amount value (inclusive). Must be >= Min.

LootboxPityRule.description: Pity guarantee rule. Fires every Threshold openings of the specific lootbox. When fired, one random reward from Pool is rolled by weights, just like normal RewardSlots. Lets pity be configured as a weighted pool rather than a single fixed award.

Pool.description: Weighted pool of possible pity rewards. Each rule fire performs one roll over Pool (by Weight, like LootboxRewardSlot.Pool). If an entry has AmountRange, it is applied to the rolled reward.

RuleID.description: Rule identifier within the lootbox (e.g. "guaranteed_5star", "guaranteed_legendary"). Used as part of the counter storage key. Must be stable — renaming resets player counters.

Threshold.description: How many openings without a hit before the reward is guaranteed. Threshold=10 means on the 10th, 20th, 30th opening the player receives a roll from Pool. Must be >= 1.

AmountRange.description: Optional range that randomly picks final Amount. On each roll N is chosen in [Min, Max] inclusive and REPLACES Amount on every Item/EventToken in Reward. Best used with single-resource Reward entries. null = use Amount from Reward as-is.

Reward.description: Resource reward of this roll. Grant-only: Standard.Items, Standard.EventTokens, PremiumTiers. For random amount use AmountRange. Use separate entries for distinct items so AmountRange doesn't apply to all simultaneously.

MinRolls.description: Number of rolls over Pool per lootbox opening. Chosen uniformly random in [Min, Max]. To make the slot guaranteed set Min=Max=1; to make it optional set Min=0.

Pool.description: Weighted reward pool of this slot. Each roll picks one entry by Weight.

SlotID.description: Slot identifier for analytics / UI / debugging ("guaranteed_coins", "bonus_item").

PityRuleSet.description: Thin wrapper for a reusable pity-rule set.

PremiumTierBonus.description: Percentage bonus on ResourceGrant.Standard for a premium tier. All Standard Amounts are multiplied by (1 + Bonus) with Math.Ceiling rounding. Applies only to Standard; in Replace mode the bonused Standard is wiped when any PremiumTier matches. Best matching tier wins, bonuses do not stack. Symmetric to PremiumTierDiscount.

Bonus.description: Bonus as a SHARE: 0.1 = +10%, 1.0 = double (x2). Empty or 0 = no bonus. The unit is the same across the whole platform — never a 0..100 percent.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

PremiumTierBundle.description: Per-tier bundle describing a structurally different set of resources (different ItemIDs/tokens/currencies) available only to subscribers. Used in both ResourceGrant.PremiumTiers (rewards) and ResourceConsume.PremiumTiers (price). Differs from PremiumTierBonus/PremiumTierDiscount which only modify Standard Amounts by percentage.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

Resources.description: Items, currencies and tokens of this tier. Entries with Amount=0 are valid and mean 'skip'. Empty/null Resources in Consume.PremiumTiers means 'premium pays nothing' (equivalent to Discounts: 1.0).

PremiumTierDiscount.description: Percentage discount on ResourceConsume.Standard for a premium tier. All Standard Amounts are multiplied by (1 - Discount) with Math.Ceiling rounding in player's favor. Applies only to Standard; ignored if PremiumTiers matches. Best matching tier wins, discounts do not stack. Symmetric to PremiumTierBonus.

Discount.description: Discount as a SHARE: 0.1 = -10%, 1.0 = free. Empty or 0 = no discount. The unit is the same across the whole platform — never a 0..100 percent.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

PresetBinding.description: Wiring for one preset block of an entity: a reference into the module's preset registry + optional keys to drop. Reusable Core container, one per preset-able block, held inside the entity's Presets container. Replaces the former scattered flat *PresetID / *Remove fields. Combination is data-driven, no mode (PresetResolver): no PresetID -> inline only; preset + empty inline -> preset; preset + inline -> merge (preset base + inline overrides/adds by key), Remove drops keys. For a single object (Character Equipment) there is nothing to key-merge, so inline wins when both are present.

PresetID.description: Preset key in the module registry (e.g. LeaderboardDefinitions.Presets.Milestones[PresetID]). Empty/null = preset unused (inline layer only).

Remove.description: Keys removed from the merged result. Dictionary key for dictionaries; element key for keyed lists (Rank / SlotID / RuleID). null = remove nothing. Ignored when no preset is set.

PriceOption.description: A single way to pay for an entity. Platform-wide standard: everything with a configured price describes it as a PriceOptions dictionary whose key is the OptionID. Options exist because ResourceConsume.Standard is charged as a whole (AND), while a price across platforms is a choice (OR): a store SKU on mobile, a token on web. Platform duties split as "the client renders, the server allows": title config ships as one immutable artifact per (version, field set), so it cannot be filtered per request — the client hides options by AllowedPlatforms, while PriceOptionSelector.Select refuses a charge whose option is not available on the caller's platform.

AllowedPlatforms.description: Platforms this option is available on. Empty/null = all of them. Do not list Unknown: a client that did not report its platform only gets options with no platform restriction, i.e. those safe everywhere.

AssetPaths.description: Option assets (currency icon, discount badge). Key = asset slug.

Cost.description: What is charged for this option. Standard is the base; PremiumDiscounts / PremiumTiers behave as everywhere else. An entry of type Purchase means the option is paid in a store rather than with a player resource: the payment is verified before ResourceService and never enters the resource operation. No initializer on purpose — "unset" must differ from "set to empty"; an unset Cost means the option is free.

Name.description: Display name of the option ("For gold", "$0.99"). A localization key or a literal — resolved client-side by the rule own table → fallback table → the key itself.

OptionID.description: Payment-option identifier. If empty, the dictionary key is substituted (PriceOptionResolver) — the client selects an option by this ID, so an option without one would be unselectable.

ResourceBundle.description: Set of items, currencies and tokens for a single operation direction (grant only or consume only).

ResourceConsume.description: Consume direction container for ResourceOperation. Two mutually exclusive premium mechanisms over Standard: PremiumTiers (priority) replaces Standard with the best matching tier's Resources via Replace, and PremiumDiscounts (fallback) applies a percentage discount to Standard only when no PremiumTier matched. Best matching tier wins, no stacking.

PremiumDiscounts.description: Percentage discount on Standard for premium players. Single best matching tier wins (no stacking): Amount = ceil(Amount * (1 - Discount)). Ignored if any PremiumTier matched — Replace takes over.

PremiumTiers.description: Structurally different price for premium players (different ItemID/CurrencyID/Target). Always Replace, single best matching tier wins. If matched, Standard is fully replaced and PremiumDiscounts is ignored; otherwise fallback to Standard + PremiumDiscounts.

Standard.description: Base — what to charge all players including F2P.

ResourceEntry.description: Universal container for a single entry in a resource bundle (item or currency). The set of populated fields depends on Type: Item uses CatalogID/ItemID/Amount; VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency uses CurrencyID/Amount; Purchase uses only ProductID (paid in a store).

Amount.description: Amount of the resource. Used by every type except Purchase, where the quantity is decided by the store itself and this field is ignored. Amount=0 is valid in Consume.PremiumTiers and means 'do not charge'.

AmountUsd.description: CryptoCurrency only: the amount in USD instead of a token count. At the moment of the operation the engine converts it to tokens at the LIVE market price of the token (charge: rounded up to a whole token; grant: rounded down). When set, Amount is ignored; the operation result carries the converted Amount.

CatalogID.description: Item catalog identifier. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs (e.g. "main", "season").

CurrencyID.description: Currency identifier. Used only when Type is VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies or cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

ItemID.description: Item identifier within the catalog. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs[Catalog].Items.

ProductID.description: IAP product identifier. Used only when Type is Purchase. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Purchase.Products — OUR stable product ID, not the store SKU (per-store SKUs live in IapProductDefinition.StoreProductIDs).

Type.description: Resource type. Determines which fields must be populated: Item (catalog item), VirtualCurrency (off-chain), CryptoCurrency (on-chain), or Purchase (real-money payment in a store).

x-enum-descriptions: Catalog item. Requires CatalogID, ItemID and Amount.
In-game (off-chain) virtual currency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies.
On-chain cryptocurrency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

Real-money payment in a store. Requires only ProductID (a product from cfg.Purchase.Products); the amount and currency are decided by the store from the SKU price tier. NOT a storable resource and never passes through ResourceService — the money is paid outside before the server learns about it, so the entry is consumed by the receipt check (ExternalPaymentGate) and stripped before the resource operation. Allowed only in Consume and only for Consumable products.

Rewarded-video credit. One credit equals one verified ad view that can be spent in systems requiring rewarded video (lootbox open, reward double, re-roll, booster). Granted +1 per server-verified view, or as N from milestones/quests/premium perks; spent -1 per gated action.

ResourceGrant.description: Grant direction container for ResourceOperation. Two independent premium mechanisms over Standard: PremiumBonuses applies a percentage uplift to Standard (single best tier wins, no stack), and PremiumTiers provides structurally different rewards governed by cfg.Reward.TierRewards (Additive or Replace mode; in Replace the bonused Standard is wiped). Both mechanisms can be used together or independently.

PremiumBonuses.description: Percentage uplift on Standard for premium players. Single best matching tier wins (no stacking): Amount = ceil(Amount * (1 + Bonus)). Wiped under Mode=Replace if any PremiumTier matches.

PremiumTiers.description: Structurally different rewards for premium players (different ItemID/Target/...). Governed by global cfg.Reward.TierRewards.RewardMode (Additive/Replace) and RewardStackLowerTiers.

Standard.description: Base — what to grant to all players including F2P.

RewardPoolLibrary.description: Library of reusable reward sets scoped to a single owning module. Each module keeps its OWN instance: LootboxDefinitions.RewardPools and CollectionDefinitions.RewardPools are two independent registries, NOT shared across the title (Lootbox presets are not visible to Collection or vice versa). The same drop-table (reward-slot set and/or pity-rule set) is authored once within the module; its entities reference it by PresetID instead of inlining a heavy pool in every entity. Resolved at read-time via RewardSlotHelpers (replace: a non-empty inline overrides the preset). null = unused.

PityPresets.description: Pity-rule sets keyed by PresetID. Mirrors the inline PityRules shape.

SlotPresets.description: Reward-slot sets keyed by PresetID. Mirrors the inline RewardSlots/BonusRewardSlots shape.

RewardSlotSet.description: Thin wrapper for a reusable reward-slot set.

SpecialTradeEventDefinition.description: SpecialTradeEvent — a limited time window in which P2P trading of Special-version Collectibles is allowed. Blitz windows (typically 4 hours) let 2-3 specific Special Collectibles be exchanged. Anti-whale mechanic.

AllowedSpecialCollectibleIDs.description: List of CollectibleIDs whose Special versions are allowed to be traded during this window. Typically 2-3 Collectibles.

EndUtc.description: End of the SpecialTradeEvent window (UTC). null = unset -> the window never opens (both bounds are required).

SpecialTradeEventDailyTradeLimit.description: Increased daily trade limit during the SpecialTradeEvent. 0 — use the global CollectionDefinitions.DailyTradeLimit.

StartUtc.description: Start of the SpecialTradeEvent window (UTC). null = unset -> the window never opens (both bounds are required).

value.description: Root collection-system config for the title. Add to TitlePublicConfigurationModel as: public CollectionDefinitions Collection { get; set; }

CollectibleJokerCatalogID.description: CatalogID of the catalog containing the joker ItemDefinition. Must reference an existing ItemCatalog in cfg.Item.Catalogs.

CollectibleJokerItemID.description: ItemID of the item used as CollectibleJoker (Wild Card). Stored in InventoryV2.Items, does not burn on season change. Granted via BonusRewardSlots, milestone rewards, streaks, event shops.

CollectionChests.description: CollectionChest configurations (Pity System mechanic). Chests spend CollectionCurrency accrued from duplicates and return guaranteed Collectibles.

Collections.description: All collections in the title. Key is CollectionID. The active collection is determined via SeasonDefinition.LinkedCollectionID (or directly when the season system is not used).

DailyTradeLimit.description: Daily limit of outgoing P2P trades per player. Controls collection completion speed via trading.

DuplicateConversions.description: Table that converts duplicates into CollectionCurrency by Collectible rarity. Conversion happens automatically when a duplicate is received.

PackTypes.description: Collection pack types (lootboxes). Key is PackTypeID. Recommended keys by descending rarity: "green", "blue", "orange", "purple".

RewardPools.description: Reusable reward-pool library scoped to THIS module (not title-wide — Lootbox has its own, separate one). PackType and CollectionChest entries reference it via their Presets container. null = presets unused.

Settings.description: Module-wide settings shared by every collection and pack type of the title. null = platform defaults apply (see CollectionDefinitionDefaults).

SpecialTradeEvents.description: SpecialTradeEvent configurations — limited time windows in which Special-version Collectibles can be exchanged. Prevents whales from completing the collection too quickly.
